claim: Lemma 4.1 establishes well-posedness of the particle dynamics under local Lipschitz continuity of the energy functional.
basis: The official v2 source numbers the result Lemma 3.1 and prints the impossible assumption E|m0|^2,E||T0||^2<0. Because squared norms and their expectations are nonnegative, the lemma is vacuous as printed; it cannot establish the unqualified claimed result without correcting the source.
scope: Falsification of the exact printed attribution. Replacing <0 by <infinity is a plausible typo repair, but that repaired lemma is a different contract.
